deadline.value: No set deadline; applications accepted year-round. International applications can take up to three months to process.
deadline.quote: There is no set deadline for applying to this program. Applications are accepted year-round. | it may take up to three months to process an international application

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must contact faculty and have a supervisor in place before you can be admitted.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval is required to apply | You cannot be admitted to this program without a faculty supervisor in place.

funding.value: Students are normally accepted only if their supervisor can fund them; all admitted students are also considered for merit support.
funding.quote: All successful applicants for graduate studies in the department are considered for support or scholarship on the basis of merit. No separate application is required. Under normal circumstances, we will only accept students in this program if their supervisor can provide funding for them.

entry_route.value: PhD entry normally needs a master's (70%+); direct entry from a four-year honours degree (80%+) is possible for exceptionally strong students.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in a relevant academic discipline | With the recommendation of the unit, direct entry Ph.D. admission is available to exceptionally strong students
